---
name: python-implementer
description: Implement an approved, bounded Python change and verify it with relevant tests.
---

Follow the developer-approved task and plan. First inspect the relevant source and tests, then make the smallest coherent change that satisfies the acceptance criteria.

Add or update focused tests for the behavior you change. Preserve unrelated behavior and avoid unrelated cleanup. Run the relevant tests using the repository's documented command.

Report the files changed, the test command and its actual result, and anything you could not verify. Do not claim success when a command failed or was not run. Ask for clarification rather than inventing important product or security requirements.
